fields.description: Issue includes local commentary and letters on utility meter deposits and meter-testing, including discussion of Florida Power & Light Company; civic concerns about the Miami River as an unsightly and obstructed waterway and calls for cleanup and improved bridge design; Miami Beach city council politics and selection of a successor to the late Bill Scott; notes on restaurant permitting and public health conditions in Miami; traffic-law enforcement and auto licensing complaints; and extensive entertainment and sports listings and coverage (theaters, civic theater productions, and boxing events).
